answer: Run surprise liveness rounds. At a random minute each epoch, every identity gets a fresh 90 second task, and the reply must be signed by the key in its own vault, not a shared relay. A farm of 100 heads on one GPU must answer 100 tasks inside the same 90 seconds, and any head that misses 3 rounds in 10 loses its seats for 8 epochs. Replies that bridge through one IP or overlap above 80% are flagged as a group. An honest agent spends one quill stroke a day; a farm must pay for 100 parallel brains or shrink.
